name.description: Package identifier; must match the directory name.

variant_group.description: Packages sharing this label are interchangeable alternatives for the same job (e.g. notes: silverbullet | memos). The picker groups them and offers them as a choice within a category.

variant_default.description: True on the one package in a variant_group that is the recommended default pick.

start_budget_seconds.description: How long the launcher waits for this stack to come up before reporting a failure. Bigger stacks (media) need a generous budget.

resources.description: Optional per-container ceilings. A home box has no spare capacity and usually no swap, so one runaway container can take the whole machine down and everything on it with it. Absent means uncapped, which is fine for anything small and well-behaved; it is declared on the packages that have actually caused trouble.

mem_limit_mb.description: Hard memory ceiling for the package's containers. The kernel kills the container when it exceeds this, which is a far better outcome than the OOM killer picking a victim at random across the whole box.

cpus.description: CPU cores this package may use, as a fraction of the host's total. 2.0 means two cores' worth.

backup.description: Which paths this package owns and what must run before they can be snapshotted consistently. See docs/BACKUP_PAGE_DESIGN.md.

before.description: Actions run before the snapshot. A database directory copied while the server is writing to it is not a backup.

sso.description: How Authelia should treat the package's vhosts. Absent block means SSO stays off (the service manages its own auth or is intentionally open on the LAN). See SsoBlock.java for the parser this mirrors.

protect.description: When true, Aurora's Caddy snippet renderer gates the package's vhosts behind Authelia forward-auth.

min_role.description: The least-privileged role that may reach the vhost. Unknown or missing values fall back to 'user' at runtime.

trusted_headers.description: True when the service reads Remote-User/Remote-Groups/Remote-Email headers Caddy injects and auto-provisions the account from them. False when Authelia only gates the front door and the service keeps its own login page.

disable_env.description: Env-var names in the package's .env to blank when SSO is enabled, neutralising internal auth for services that would otherwise show a second login page after Authelia already granted access.

probe.description: How the control plane checks whether the package is up. Shape varies by kind (docker | http_json | smb); validated loosely on purpose.

subpackages.description: User-facing children shown under the package's row on the dashboard, each with its own status probe.

warnings.description: Pre-install advisories evaluated against the host resource snapshot.
